cmsFields.title: Svelte review: compiler and reactivity trade-offs
cmsFields.subtitle: Does compiler-led UI development simplify state without hiding lifecycle responsibilities?
cmsFields.summary: Svelte repository review of compilation, state proxies and browser-only effects, with adoption checks and limits from a pinned source snapshot.
keyTakeaways: The compiler pipeline is visible in the public compile entry point.
State proxies are granular, but destructured values are not automatically live bindings.
Effects are browser-only and require dependency and cleanup discipline.
